nodes.title: Stoicism
nodes.description: Immune to control. Attacks against you cannot be evaded.

nodes.title: Unlimited Power
nodes.description: +1% increased physical damage per point of Strength. Health recovery reduced by 25%.

nodes.title: Iron Will
nodes.description: All Evade is converted to Armor.

nodes.title: Wind of Freedom
nodes.description: All Armor is converted to Evade.

nodes.title: Poisonous Bite
nodes.description: Each attack applies a Poison stack (75% of total attack damage). Each stack lasts 3 turns.

nodes.title: Vicious Bite
nodes.description: +1% poison damage multiplier for every point of Poison Resistance above the maximum. Poison Resistance reduced by 60%.

nodes.title: Mind over Matter
nodes.description: +3 Barrier per point of Intelligence. Barrier recovery reduced by 35%.

nodes.title: Elemental Fury
nodes.description: Attacks penetrate elemental resistances by your own overcap above the maximum. Your resistances are reduced by 45%. (No passive skill written yet.)

nodes.title: Trinity
nodes.description: Attacks convert their physical damage into cold, fire and lightning in equal thirds; no physical damage remains. (No passive skill written yet.)

nodes.title: Elemental Lord
nodes.description: +1% increased elemental damage per point of Intelligence.

nodes.title: Cold Mind
nodes.description: +2% increased cold damage for every 15 Mana.

nodes.title: Gift of Nature
nodes.description: All elemental damage increased by 35%. Attacks deal no physical damage.

nodes.title: Strength of Spirit
nodes.description: 35% chance to restore 5% of maximum Mana when hit. Mana recovery reduced by 25%.

nodes.title: Agnostic
nodes.description: All Mana is converted to Health. Abilities are paid for with Health. Activation cost increased by 25%.
